slides.head:
Kling 4.0 is out. One prompt
now runs a 30-second take.
30 seconds, native.
slides.body: Kling 4.0 generates 30-second clips in a single pass. Upload an existing video and it extends the story up to two minutes.

slides.head:
10 keyframes.
15 references.
slides.body: Omni Reference takes up to 10 keyframes and 15 reference assets: images, video and audio. The aim is one character that holds across shots and episodes.

slides.head: Direct the camera.
slides.body: Push-ins, pull-outs, pans, tracking and orbit shots stay stable. White-model and depth-map videos can guide performance and camera movement.

slides.head: HDR and ultrawide, soon.
slides.body: Kling says 10-bit HDR at 4K and 1080p and a 21:9 format are coming. Prompts run to 8,000 tokens. Firefly gets Kling 4.0 soon.

slides.head:
Stop prompting clips.
Start directing scenes.
slides.body: Thirty seconds is a scene, not a clip. Camera moves and continuity now decide the result, not the prompt alone. Live on the Kling site today; API later.
